Load-bearing mutations killed include missing canonical-absence closure, retired profile-tag decoding, constructor/Mirror boundaries, and consumer closure failures.

Consumer prototype /tmp/storyatlas-output-prototype.XKrP8n against the finalized provider: scalafmtCheckAll and compileAll exit 0; CLI 32/32; layout JS 26/26; layout JVM targeted Paginator 14/14 plus War of the Ghosts 5/5; Intaglio JVM 14/14 and JS 14/14; app 22/22 plus fastLinkJS. External-package compile probes prove callers cannot construct Verified local-open certification.

Final deterministic artifacts: /private/tmp/story-output-final-v6-a and -v6-b are byte-identical. Independent manifest verification matched all six declared lengths and SHA-256 values. BundleId is manifest SHA-256 42068a686d5e328ad7ee7d3625bff059471848c915fe9cea5240b758e9780e87. Profile remains NotAttempted verification_not_run because no controlled browser court ran.

Known limitations requiring chief rulings: StoryAtlas publication uses new JNA 5.19.0 for Darwin renameatx_np RENAME_EXCL, fails closed as Unsupported elsewhere, and Java 25 warns that future native access will require an enable-native-access flag. Full AWT measurer test still aborts before test start on Java 25 and is not claimed. Provider base c8ffe86 is stale relative to current main, so authorization must be followed by fresh export, port, reference-scope/all-platform re-gate, and sibling seam.

Still missing: chief-created child bead, exact provider path reservation, codec-to-view ADR/dependency ruling, public vocabulary authorization, and separate StoryAtlas dependency/path authority. Epic explicitly says no implementation is authorized. This post requests those gates; it does not claim candidate or landing authority.
